title: Scrape Save omits naming, delays confirmation, and opens an unusable filing browser
severity: S2: central capture workflow is confusing and slow; users cannot name the Source at save time
preconditions: Use the installed development extension in Chrome on a content page with a captured article; sign in and select an organization.
reproduction: Open Scrape, capture the page, click Save.
Observe that no editable Source name or destination choice appears before the write.
After Saved, inspect the automatic filing panel: Library selector, broad eight-type browse list, and a second File action.
Try to scroll the Projects list to a project beyond the first visible rows; the list does not scroll to it.
Observe the additional wait between the Source landing and the Saved state.
expected: A compact save dialog immediately offers a prefilled editable name and a fast optional destination choice; one primary Save lands the named Source with selected associations and shows confirmation promptly. Project search and scrolling reach every result. Full browsing and Library loading occur only on request.
actual: The compact pre-save form and prompt landing are implemented. Valid native-5 confirmed a named Source and persisted Project association. Valid native-6 on the imported CI development artifact source af13274c35ee16e28014e90b1e50c73ad433d348 / version 0.2.457 confirmed the editable Name, full captured URL displayed as non-input text, one-click Projects results, visible list scrolling, keyboard project selection, and Tab/Shift+Tab focus wrap. Source 39378ff2-1a20-4999-9f53-d9735bc04bbc (EXT-D-0187 Native Save 6 2026-10-10) reopened with Saved state, full URL, and captured content; Project 4484ab9c-bb04-4adc-a894-df2e9f18960f showed it among 3 attached Sources after refresh. Later shared-main cleanup commits da2e314b0 and 21f07fb92 were not in this artifact. Duplicate, no-destination, refusal/retry, additional destination/Library/File elsewhere paths, and guest/member role coverage remain unverified. EXT-D-0187 remains in-fix.
evidence: User-provided Scrape and filing screenshots plus report that the Projects list does not scroll (2026-10-09, captured in task)
cause: Original client path omitted name/attach_to and awaited ancillary SEO audit. Subsequent native retest exposed modal focus escape and incomplete one-type browsing. A separate initial-organization hydration race remounted/dismissed the Save form and caused cumulative 10-second test waits; the builder repaired hydration/switch handling and the focused suite now passes.
